asset.name: PartToWholeCharts
asset.description: The donut, segmented, funnel, and proportional family with explicit labelling and safeguards against displays that mislead or become unreadable below a slice threshold.

requires.reason: Framework, legends, and states are shared.

rationale: Carries a deliberate guardrail: below a readable slice threshold the family must aggregate into an other category rather than render slivers nobody can see or click.
